contribution._instruction: Add all the contributions made to this research product version.

contributorAffiliation._instruction: Add all the affiliations of the contributors to this research product version.

description._instruction: Enter a description (or abstract) of this research product. Note that this should be a suitable description for all attached research product versions.

fullName._instruction: Enter a descriptive full name (or title) for this research product. Note that this should be a suitable full name for all attached research product versions.

homepage._instruction: Enter the internationalized resource identifier (IRI) to the homepage of this research product.

howToCite._instruction: Enter the preferred citation text for this research product. Leave blank if citation text can be extracted from the assigned digital identifier.

shortName._instruction: Enter a short name (or alias) for this research product that could be used as a shortened display title (e.g., for web services with too little space to display the full name).
